name: SF Tools - Complete Metadata & User Setup
description: Creates comprehensive test metadata: Users, Roles, Permission Sets, Validation Rules, Custom Fields, Picklists. Run FIRST before any other tests.
preconditions: User is logged into Salesforce org as System Administrator
Org has available metadata deployment capacity

steps.description: Navigate to Salesforce Home
Create test Role hierarchy for testing role-based visibility
Create test Permission Sets with different access levels
Create Permission Set Group combining multiple permission sets
Create 4 test users using available licenses: 2 Salesforce Full, 1 Platform, 1 Chatter Free
steps.expectedResult: 4 test users created: Admin, Standard, Platform, Chatter

steps.description: Assign permission sets to test users based on their roles
steps.expectedResult: Permission sets assigned to all 4 users

steps.action: Create Custom Field - Account Rating Picklist
steps.description: Create custom picklist field on Account via Tooling API

Metadata.label: Flowstral Rating
Metadata.description: Test picklist for SF Tools testing

steps.action: Create Custom Field - Account Priority Picklist
steps.description: Create another custom picklist field on Account

steps.action: Create Custom Field - Contact Status Picklist
steps.description: Create custom picklist field on Contact

steps.action: Create Validation Rule - Account Website Required
steps.description: Create validation rule on Account

Metadata.description: Requires website for Customer accounts - Flowstral Test
Metadata.errorMessage: Website is required for Customer - Direct accounts

steps.action: Create Validation Rule - Contact Email Format
steps.description: Create validation rule on Contact for email format

Metadata.description: Validates email format contains @ and . - Flowstral Test
Metadata.errorMessage: Please enter a valid email address

steps.description: Create validation rule on Opportunity for minimum amount

Metadata.description: Minimum opportunity amount of $1000 - Flowstral Test
Metadata.errorMessage: Opportunity amount must be at least $1,000

steps.description: Query to verify roles were created

args.query: SELECT Id, Name, DeveloperName, ParentRoleId FROM UserRole WHERE DeveloperName LIKE 'Flowstral_Test%' ORDER BY Name

steps.description: Query to verify permission sets were created

args.query: SELECT Id, Name, Label, Description FROM PermissionSet WHERE Name LIKE 'Flowstral_Test%'

steps.description: Query to verify test users were created

args.query: SELECT Id, Username, FirstName, LastName, Profile.Name, UserRole.Name, IsActive FROM User WHERE Username LIKE '%flowstral.test%'

steps.description: Query validation rules via Tooling API

args.query: SELECT Id, ValidationName, Active, EntityDefinition.QualifiedApiName FROM ValidationRule WHERE ValidationName LIKE 'Flowstral%'

steps.description: Query custom fields via Tooling API

args.query: SELECT Id, DeveloperName, TableEnumOrId FROM CustomField WHERE DeveloperName LIKE 'Flowstral%'

steps.description: Verify correct number of roles created

args.query: SELECT COUNT() FROM UserRole WHERE DeveloperName LIKE 'Flowstral_Test%'

steps.description: Verify correct number of permission sets

args.query: SELECT COUNT() FROM PermissionSet WHERE Name LIKE 'Flowstral_Test%'

steps.description: Verify 4 test users exist (Admin, Standard, Platform, Chatter)

args.query: SELECT COUNT() FROM User WHERE Username LIKE '%flowstral.test%' AND IsActive = true

steps.action: Create 4 Test Users (Admin, Standard, Platform, Chatter)
